title: Rules and gates reference projection
description:
Add a new rendering function that produces a rules/gates reference document from the rule and gate registries, following jit's existing projection pattern: the same projection-mode/projection-style configuration, region-splicing, and atomic-write mechanism that today renders the invariant reference into CLAUDE.md. This is a new, generically-typed render function, not a reuse of the existing invariant-specific renderer, which is typed specifically to the invariant registry and cannot render rules or gates directly.

The target file and heading/region for the rendered reference are config-declared via the existing projection-style configuration, so the exact destination is chosen when this item is implemented rather than hardcoded.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: a new render function produces a rules/gates reference document from the rule and gate registries, using the projection mechanism (projection mode/style, region splicing, atomic write), not the invariant-typed renderer.
- [hard] REQ-02: the target file and projection style are config-declared; a render test produces the reference document from the registries.

Blast radius: a new renderer module alongside the existing projection code; reuses the existing region-splicing function and the existing invariant-projection orchestration as a pattern, not by direct call.
